summary: Performance degradation observed when adding TOP 1 to a query involving joins and ORDER BY.
symptoms: Query plan changes from Hash Match to Nested Loops with Table Spool
mechanism: Row Goal optimization changes the query plan, leading to inefficient execution paths.

value.sql: SELECT TOP 1 dc.DOCUMENT_ID, dc.COPIES, dc.REQUESTOR, dc.D_ID, cj.FILE_NUMBER FROM DOCUMENT_QUEUE dc JOIN CORRESPONDENCE_JOURNAL cj ON dc.DOCUMENT_ID = cj.DOCUMENT_ID WHERE dc.QUEUE_DATE <= GETDATE() AND dc.PRINT_LOCATION = 2 ORDER BY cj.FILE_NUMBER
